d:
Indiya blok ki taraph se ravivar, 1 navanbar ko dilli ke ramlila maidan men ek raili ka aayojan kiya gaya. ye raili esaaaeeaar aur mukhy chunav aayukt gyanesh kumar ke khilaf aayojit ki gaee thi. is dauran rahul gandhi se lekar tejasvi yadav, akhilesh yadav aur mamta banarji ne logon ko sanbodhit kiya. magar vipaksh isse jo hasil karna chahta tha kya vo kar paya? ya vipaksh ke samne ab bhi chunautiyan hain? chalie yahi samajhne ki koshish karte hain.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
